description: Soft-delete a durable house project you own. Idempotent -- deleting an already-deleted, unknown, or not-owned project_id returns the same successful-shaped response either way, and never discloses which case occurred. Version rows are never physically erased. Once deleted, a project can no longer be resolved by project_id or house_ref.

project_id.description: The project_id returned by house_specify for an authenticated (keyed) call.

name: project_delete
title: Delete a Durable Project
